label: William of Ockham, Summa logicae I.15: A universal in the natural-sign sense is an intention of…
locator: I.15: opening arguments and final paragraphs beginning Et ideo simpliciter and Ex quibus aliisque
interpretation: Bounded prose reading of the materialized Latin; no Lean declaration or mechanically verified inference is advertised. Attributes the natural-sign thesis and retains the qualification on the act-of-understanding analysis. The text offers arguments; this prose record is not a Lean verification of those arguments or a denial of individual substances.
